note: Queries: Buena Vista/Storm Lake July 2024 flooding; Little Sioux River July 2024 Cherokee; Iowa DOT July 2024 reopenings; Okoboji no-wake lifted July 2024. Found continuing Dickinson County lake flooding (DCEM 7/3 release; Explore Okoboji 7/18: 5 mph rule and West Okoboji above 6.20-ft threshold to July 17). No usable July-window coverage found for Akron, Granite, Greenville, Everly, Fostoria or for Buena Vista/Cherokee/Clay/Lyon/O'Brien counties; July articles for Cherokee/Spencer were June-flood recovery (191899_0). Sioux City Journal/Nonpareil July lake stories paywalled.

Queries: May 2024 Iowa flash flooding Cherokee Larrabee; Everly Iowa flooding May 2024; KICD Spencer May 2024 Clay County; Iowa flash flooding May 6/7 2024; Okoboji May 2024 lake levels. No news coverage of flood impacts in Cherokee/Clay/Dickinson/O'Brien counties for May 1-17, 2024 was found; results were dominated by the June 2024 event.

Queries: northwest Iowa May 21 2024 flash flood; Radio Iowa May 2024 flooding; NWS May 21 2024 event pages. Radio Iowa (5/22/2024) reported roads closed in rural southeastern Clay County (near Webb) after torrential May 20-21 rain - one record. No Cherokee/Dickinson/O'Brien or Everly/Fostoria/Larrabee/Montgomery/Rossie-specific impacts found; NWS DMX May 21 page covers central Iowa.

Queries: Iowa Great Lakes high water/docks June 2024; Iowa June 8/9/13 2024 heavy rain Spencer Milford Clay Dickinson. Only Explore Okoboji 6/6/2024 found: dock/hoist damage explicitly attributed to strong wind (rejected), lake levels below action thresholds. No flood impacts that already happened were reported for Clay/Dickinson June 1-14, 2024.

Queries: Spencer/Okoboji storms June 16-17 2024; Iowa Great Lakes no-wake June 2024. KTIV 6/17/2024: Dickinson County emergency 5 mph rule (approved 6/17, effective 6/18) and ~10 gpm sewage discharge into West Lake Okoboji - 2 records. Spencer and other Clay/Dickinson impacts of June 20-30 were deliberately skipped per instruction (belong to 191899_0 except 193924_0/193882_0 counties/windows).

Queries: Sibley Osceola June 2024; Hartley Sanborn O'Brien June 2024; Arnolds Park/Okoboji June 21-22 2024; Hull/Boyden June 20 2024. Strong coverage: Hartley Sentinel 6/27 (evacuation of ~25, 5 basement collapses, lift station out), Explore Okoboji (Okoboji street flooding, 10-15 shoreline collapses, Spirit Lake sewers overwhelmed, Dickinson A-43 bridge abutment washout), Iowa DOT 6/22 closures (Dickinson/O'Brien/Sioux), USGS record Ocheyedan River peak (Osceola). No Sibley- or Sanborn-specific impact text found (KIWA piece was process-only); Hull-specific impacts not found (Rock Valley coverage excluded).

Queries: Rock Rapids June 21 2024 Rock River; George Iowa June 2024 Lyon County damage; weather.gov FSD event page. Rich Rock Rapids coverage (Dakota News Now 6/23; Radio Iowa/KIWA 7/23: ~900 homes with basement water, 20-30 homes and up to 30 businesses with main-floor water; rescues; water/power out; streets destroyed), Lyon County: 5 bridges damaged (N'West Iowa REVIEW), DOT travel discouraged/closures 6/22. George/Matlock/Hull-specific impacts not found (only rainfall totals in NWS FSD summary).

Queries: Waterloo Iowa flash flooding May 21 2024; Des Moines Iowa flash flooding May 21 2024 water rescue; Waterloo Evansdale Iowa flooding May 2024 roads closed; KWWL Waterloo Black Hawk County flooding May 22 2024; May 21/22 2024 Des Moines heavy rain. NWS DMX May 20-21 event summary yielded Tama (Meskwaki water rescues) and Marshall (landslides on roads) records. Kellogg/Baxter home flooding and evacuations are Jasper County (outside county list) and the 75-100 road closures across central Iowa statement is not county-attributable, so both were excluded. Black Hawk County closure articles exist (Courier, KWWL) but were paywalled/rate-limited; no reachable Polk/Black Hawk specifics.

Query: Dubuque Iowa flash flooding June 3 2024. Strong same-day coverage from KCRG, CBS2/KGAN, KWWL: named flooded streets, road closures, stranded vehicles, traffic signals down. 4 records extracted for Dubuque; no coverage found naming Asbury, Center Grove, Key West, or Sageville specifically.

Queries: Burlington Iowa Mississippi River flooding July 2024 crest; Dubuque Mississippi River crest July 2024 flooding closed; Muscatine Iowa Mississippi River flooding July 2024; Burlington Hawk Eye flooding July 2024; Louisa County Toolesboro flooding July 2024. Extracted Muscatine road/park/overbank records (KWQC, WVIK) and Dubuque lock closure, boating ban, overbank records (KCRG, KIYX). Burlington coverage found was preparation/forecast only or undated - no Burlington records; no Louisa/Toolesboro coverage found. Telegraph Herald and Muscatine Journal recaps unreachable (429/paywall).

Queries: Humboldt County Dakota City Iowa flooding July 2024 Des Moines River; Emmetsburg Iowa flooding July 2024 West Fork Des Moines River; Fort Dodge Webster County Des Moines River flooding July 2024. All hits concern the late-June record flooding (crests June 25-28, part of the separate June episode) rather than the July 1-15 window; WHO13 Fort Dodge piece was 403-blocked and likely late-June anyway. No in-window records extracted.

Queries: Eagle Grove Clarion Iowa flooding July 8 2024 Wright County; flash flooding Iowa July 8 2024 Franklin Wright rainfall Dows Clarion; KIMT Globe Gazette flash flooding north Iowa July 8 2024; KGLO flash flooding July 8 2024. Radio Iowa article Exceptionally heavy rainfall brings flash flooding in Franklin, Wright counties (2024-07-08) and a KIMT county-by-county breakdown were located but both were unreachable (redirect loop / 429), so no records could be extracted.

Queries: Iowa City Coralville flash flooding July 2 2024 streets; July 2 2024 Iowa flash flood Johnson County. NWS Quad Cities event summary (summary_07022024) provided local storm reports: Thornburg/Keokuk gravel road overtopped, Coralville street flooding/closure with stranded vehicles, University Heights roadway under 8-10 inches, Iowa City roadway inundated with water against homes. Gazette article on the same storms was 429-unreachable; KCRG July 2 piece was forecast-only.

Queries: Missouri River Iowa flooding July 2024 Fremont Mills Pottawattamie road closures; I-29 reopened Iowa flooding July 2024; Fremont County Iowa flooding July 2024 Bartlett levee; Harrison County Iowa Mondamin flooding July 2024. Iowa DOT July 3 notice confirms I-29/I-680 closures persisted July 1-3 (record); Missouri Valley Times recap gave Harrison County flooded roads and levee breaches but the article is undated so its records were rejected under inclusion rule 3. Pottawattamie County EMA pages (June 24-26) document the closure onset but predate the window. KMA Land Fremont County article unreachable (429); no reachable Mills/Fremont (Bartlett, Folsom) specifics.

Queries: Ankeny Iowa flooding April 22 2022 flash flood; Marshalltown Iowa flooding April 2022; April 22 2022 Iowa flash flooding Ankeny Huxley; KCCI/WHO13 variants, Times-Republican archive. Found Local 5 rain-totals/flash-flood article (Huxley stalled truck, fields/streets/neighborhoods flooded); WHO13/weareiowa follow-ups and Yahoo photo galleries 403/429 or wrong year; no Times-Republican April 2022 flood story.

Queries: Big Sioux April 2023 Akron/Hawarden, nwestiowa, KTIV, Linn Grove/Little Sioux April 2023, Rock Rapids/Lyon Co, KELO, KIWA/KLEM, NWS FSD. Only usable find: Storm Lake Radio warning item with Sioux Rapids city park flooded (date inferred to 2023-04-15). Sioux City Journal paywalled; KCAU/siouxlandproud/chronicletimes 403; most results were June 2024 or 2019 floods.

Queries: Iowa flash flooding May 15 2023 Howard Mitchell Winneshiek; Nashua Cedar/Little Cedar May 2023; KIMT Mitchell/Osage; Decorah Upper Iowa May 2023; May 14/15 2023 river flood warning. Queries: Spencer Iowa flooding May 2023 Clay County; stormlakeradio/KICD Little Sioux May 2023. Found Storm Lake Radio flood-warning item whose Wed-Fri day pattern fits May 17-19, 2023 (mentions warnings at Spencer and near Milford) but it is forecast/warning-only with no realized impacts and no printed date - rejected. Most other results were the June 2024 Spencer flood.

Queries: Spencer Iowa flooding July 2022; Okoboji Milford July 2022 Dickinson; Iowa Great Lakes July 2022 KUOO. Results dominated by June 2024 flood; the one candidate (Siouxland Proud wastewater-discharge article near Okoboji) returned 403 and its date could not be verified. No usable coverage.
